sentence: GraphNode fields are read from node (a GraphNode parameter in getDomainMeta and elements of graph.nodes) and KnowledgeGraph edges/nodes are read from graph, a parameter typed KnowledgeGraph in buildDomainOverview and buildDomainDetail.
filePath, summary, complexity and tags are read from node, which is an element of graph.nodes at line 567 and an explicit GraphNode parameter in buildCustomFlowNode.
edges, layers and nodes are read from graph, the KnowledgeGraph-typed parameter of prepareLayout.

GraphNode fields (domainMeta, figmaMeta, knowledgeMeta, filePath, lineRange, complexity, summary, tags, languageNotes) are read from node props typed GraphNode or found in activeGraph.nodes, and edges/nodes are read from graph props typed KnowledgeGraph.
nodes, layers and tour are read from graph, a KnowledgeGraph-typed parameter of buildGraphIndexes and getSortedTour.
source/target are read from e in edges typed GraphEdge[] in aggregateContainerEdges, and layers/edges are read from graph typed KnowledgeGraph in aggregateLayerEdges.
source and target are read from edge, an element of the edges parameter typed GraphEdge[] in filterEdges.
source and target are read from e, an element of the edges parameter typed GraphEdge[] in detectCommunities.
nodes, edges, layers and project are read from graph, the KnowledgeGraph-typed parameter of buildChatContext.
source/target are read from edge in edges destructured from graph typed KnowledgeGraph, and filePath/lineRange/languageNotes are read from targetNode, the GraphNode-typed property of ExplainContext.
details and content are read from partial, the parameter of OnUpdateCallback typed AgentToolResult<SubagentDetails>.
isError and durationMs are read from outcome, a local declared as AgentToolCallOutcome.
outputSchema, prepareArguments, executionMode and execute are read from tool, the AgentTool<any> parameter of createToolDefinitionFromAgentTool.

env and auth are read from result declared as AuthResult | undefined, and apiKey/headers are read from auth, the ModelAuth parameter of withConfiguredAuth.
lastModified and models are read from entry, the ModelsStoreEntry | undefined parameter of remoteModels.
auth, baseUrl and headers are read from provider, the Provider-typed parameter of describeProvider.

providers and allowNetwork are read from options typed ModelsRefreshOptions in refresh (the cited signal read at 256 is on another options), and aborted/errors are read from result returned as ModelsRefreshResult by this.models.refresh.

auth, baseUrl and headers are read from base typed Provider | undefined, and signal/credential are read from context, the parameter of the Provider.refreshModels implementation contextually typed RefreshModelsContext.
stored, allowNetwork, signal and force are read from context, the parameter of refreshModels in the returned Provider, contextually typed RefreshModelsContext.
stored, allowNetwork, signal and credential are read from context, explicitly typed RefreshModelsContext in refreshModels.
persist and update are read from publication, explicitly typed ModelsPublication at line 166 and contextually typed via RefreshModelsContext.publish at line 120.
persist and update are read from publication, the ModelsPublication-typed parameter of publish.
api, models, setResponses, appendResponses, getPendingResponseCount and unregister are read from fauxProvider, a local declared as FauxProviderRegistration.
The cited role and content reads are on elements of context.messages and agent.state.messages (Message/AgentMessage unions, narrowed to system or user), not on a value typed AssistantMessage.

Only content is read from a parameter naming AssistantMessage (getTextContent); the cited role read at line 59 is on agent.state.messages[2], an AgentMessage union element, so a second field read from the shape is not established.

provider/model and stopReason are read from message parameters typed AssistantMessage (_modelForMessage, _dispatchTurnEndBoundary), and contextWindow/maxTokens/reasoning are read from values typed Model<any>.
reasoning, contextWindow, maxTokens, samplingParams, compat and thinkingLevelMap are read from model, the Model<Api> parameter of describeModel.

AssistantMessage fields are read from assistantMsg/assistant cast as AssistantMessage, SystemMessage fields from system cast as SystemMessage, and Usage fields from usage, the Usage parameter of calculateContextTokens.
All cited fields are read from usage, first and second, parameters typed Usage in addUsageToTotals and combineUsage.

stopReason, errorMessage and diagnostics are read from message parameters typed AssistantMessage, and Usage fields are read from usage destructured from notice whose usage property is typed Usage, although the cited content/role reads at 3810-3812 are on a user Message.
The cited role and content reads are on elements of context.messages filtered to user messages, not on any value typed AssistantMessage.
readFile and access are read from readOps, the ReadOperations value returned by createGondolinReadOps.
formFactor and userAgent are read from editorInterface, the EditorInterface-typed parameter of canResizeFromSides.
canFitSidebar, desktopUIMode, formFactor and isTouchScreen are read from this.editorInterface, a class property declared as EditorInterface.
offset and opacity are read from renderState, the ElementRenderState-typed parameter of the link icon renderer.
fixedPoint and elementId are read from binding, the FixedPointBinding-typed parameter of _renderBinding.
fixedPoint, mode and elementId are read from binding, a parameter typed FixedPointBinding | null.
color is read from el typed DebugElement in render, and permanent is read from el in frames of window.visualDebug.data typed DebugElement[][].
elements and appState are read from data, a local declared as ImportedDataState.
imageCache, theme and isExporting are read from renderConfig, parameters typed StaticCanvasRenderConfig.
setActiveTool and setCursor are read from excalidrawAPI, a prop typed ExcalidrawImperativeAPI.
The cited API methods are read from excalidrawAPI, state declared via useState<ExcalidrawImperativeAPI | null>.

exportBackground and viewBackgroundColor are read from appState typed Partial<AppState>, and the API methods are read from excalidrawAPI typed ExcalidrawImperativeAPI (from initializeScene opts or ExcalidrawAPIContext).
The cited API methods are read from this.excalidrawAPI, declared as CollabProps["excalidrawAPI"], which is ExcalidrawImperativeAPI.
getAppState and getFiles are read from excalidrawAPI, a prop typed ExcalidrawImperativeAPI.
scrollX, scrollY and zoom are read from appState, parameters typed AppState in render and _debugRenderer.
x and y are read from topLeft, a Point-typed parameter of makeQuad.
focused and children are read from node, the SerializedAXNode | null parameter of findFocusedNode.

downloadBaseUrl and skipDownload are read from defaultConfig, declared as ChromeSettings | ChromeHeadlessShellSettings | FirefoxSettings, and the Configuration fields are read from configuration declared as Configuration.

downloadBaseUrl is read from the configuration parameter declared as ChromeSettings | ChromeHeadlessShellSettings | FirefoxSettings, and skipDownload is read from configuration.chrome (typed ChromeSettings) at line 83, although the cited line 71 reads skipDownload from a Configuration.
extraPrefsFirefox, args and executablePath are read from defaultBrowserOptions, a const declared as LaunchOptions.
